text:
6. [RARC.5.6.7] Runs each RHS action in the order the artefact declares: an
   `emit` or a `withdraw` changes working memory directly, and every other verb
   goes through the dispatcher ([RARC.5.7.1]).

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__action_step
idris.note: One dispatched action preserves the invariant and extends progress: a no-op changes nothing, a real emit or withdraw lowers its stratum's first component or touches a kind the stratum does not read, and no earlier stratum sees it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_step
idris.note: The same across the whole RHS.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action
idris.note: Dispatch of one action with immediate propagation: an emit or withdraw that changed working memory reaches Rete before the next action of the same RHS, and the running RHS keeps its bindings. `emit` and `withdraw` only -- the two verbs the clause says change working memory directly. The verbs that go through the dispatcher ([RARC.5.7.1]: `call`, `publish`, `cache` and `cache_delete`, `log`) have no model here; a `log` is an effect record of the Idris model's trace (Rete/NetworkTraced.idr), changing no engine state.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions
idris.note: The RHS actions in order, each dispatched as above.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__action_agrees
idris.note: On an explicit-only program one action with truth maintenance is the core's action.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_agree
idris.note: And so is a whole RHS.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_tms
idris.note: One action with truth maintenance: the core's action, the justification it records, then the cascade its retraction started, before the next action. `emit` and `withdraw` only, as for the core; the dispatched verbs of [RARC.5.7.1] have no model.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_tms
idris.note: The RHS actions in order, each as above.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_net
idris.note: One RHS action against the engine, the fired match bound: an emit under the lifecycle, or a withdraw.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_net
idris.note: The RHS actions in order, each propagated before the next.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__do_action_acc
idris.note: One emit or withdraw on the accumulator: Rete/NetworkTimed.idr's stamped action; the trackers and the records stand.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__do_actions_called
idris.note: The RHS with calls: at each position the sites there, then the action there; the sites past the last action after it.

idris.name: rlow_7_3_8__no_site_is_the_stamped_rhs
idris.note: WITH NO SITE THE FOLD IS THE STAMPED RHS, from any position, the trackers and records untouched. By induction on the actions, over every program and state.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_unique
idris.note: One RHS action keeps one live fact per key.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_unique
idris.note: The RHS keeps one live fact per key.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_net_view
idris.note: ONE RHS ACTION keeps the view.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_net_view
idris.note: The RHS keeps the view.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_net_ordered
idris.note: ONE RHS ACTION keeps the order.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_net_ordered
idris.note: The RHS keeps the order.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_g
idris.note: One RHS action with the set beside it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_g_fst
idris.note: The ghost's action is the model's.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_sound
idris.note: ONE RHS ACTION keeps the ghost sound.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_g
idris.note: The RHS with the set beside it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_g_fst
idris.note: The ghost's RHS is the model's.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_sound
idris.note: The RHS keeps the ghost sound.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_stamped
idris.note: ONE ACTION, STAMPED: Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's action on the net, and the stamps updated at the net's clock over the working memory the action read. LESS than the clause: `emit` and `withdraw`, which change working memory; every other verb goes through the dispatcher and is an effect the harness renders, not engine state.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_stamped
idris.note: THE RHS, STAMPED, action by action in the order the artefact declares. LESS than the clause as `rarc_5_6_7__do_action_stamped` is.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_stamped_net
idris.note: THE STAMPED RHS'S NET IS Rete/NetworkTtl.idr's: the stamps ride beside and change nothing the actions compute, over every program, action list, net and stamp table.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_tms_net_succ
idris.note: One more action at the front of an RHS on the network, when the first is known.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_tms_fl_unfold
idris.note: FireLoop's action, when the core action is known.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_tms_net
idris.note: One action on the network: the dispatch, the justification it records, then the cascade its retraction started, before the next action.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_tms_net_unfold
idris.note: The network's action, when the dispatch is known.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_tms_net
idris.note: The RHS on the network, action by action, the cascade in the loop.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_action_tms_agree
idris.note: ONE ACTION AGREES: the core actions agree, both record the same row against the same working memory, and the cascades agree.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_actions_tms_agree
idris.note: THE RHS AGREES, with the table and the cascade in the loop.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_emit
idris.note: The Emit action is the named assert-then-propagate on its bound facts.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_action_agree
idris.note: ONE RHS ACTION keeps the agreement: an emit is the assert on both sides, a withdraw the retraction, on one working memory.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_actions_agree
idris.note: THE RHS keeps the agreement: the actions in order, each keeping it.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_well
idris.note: One RHS action keeps the state well-formed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_well
idris.note: The RHS keeps the state well-formed.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_ttl_fl_succ
idris.note: The same on FireLoop with the deadline table.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_ttl_net_succ
idris.note: One more action at the front of an RHS on the network, when the first is known.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_ttl_net
idris.note: One action on the network, and the deadline its emit mints.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_ttl_net
idris.note: The RHS on the network, the deadline table threaded through.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_action_ttl_agree
idris.note: ONE ACTION AGREES, the deadline it stamps included.

idris.name: rlow_4_2_1__do_actions_ttl_agree
idris.note: THE RHS AGREES, the deadline table threaded through both.

idris.name: Rarc_5_6_7__action_shape
idris.note: What a core action that changed working memory did to it: kept every surviving id's fact, added at most facts with an id neither live before nor bound by the firing token, left ids unique, and touched only one kind, one the rule writes.

idris.name: iret_12_2__action_cascade
idris.note: One action of the dispatcher with truth maintenance keeps the firing invariant, and its cascade is Rete/Refcount.idr's cascade of the table it recorded.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__action_core
idris.note: One core action from an invariant state with unique ids: the invariant holds after, and working memory is unchanged with the tables, or changed with the action shape and propagated. `emit` (no-op, append, entity replace) and `withdraw` (no-op, remove).

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__action_noop
idris.note: An action that changed nothing.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_tms_inv
idris.note: The whole RHS keeps the firing invariant.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_tms_succ
idris.note: One more action at the front of an RHS, when the first is known.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__action_ttl_engine
idris.note: One action agrees with the engine's on the engine.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__action_ttl_inv
idris.note: One action keeps the firing invariant and the deadline table's well-formedness: the core action mints at most the fresh id, and the cascade only removes facts.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_ttl_clock
idris.note: An RHS does not touch the clock.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_ttl_engine
idris.note: The whole RHS agrees with the engine's on the engine.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_ttl_inv
idris.note: And so does the whole RHS.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__actions_ttl_succ
idris.note: Unfolding the RHS by one action.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_tms_unfold
idris.note: The engine's action, given the core action's result: record the row, then cascade.

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_action_ttl
idris.note: One action: the engine's, and the deadline the emit mints, at the clock the firing read [IRET.25.4.1].

idris.name: rarc_5_6_7__do_actions_ttl
idris.note: The whole RHS, the deadline table threaded through.
